**Build**: the version line the miner prints at start (for example redPeaRL 0.7.0-beta.6), or BUILD.txt in the package.
**Card and driver**: for example RX 9070 XT, Adrenalin 26.10.1.
**OS**: Windows 10/11, or Linux distribution + ROCm version.
**Pool**: the pool preset or URL (no wallet address, please).

**What happened**:

**What you expected**:

**Log**: the last 200 lines of miner.log (next to the miner). At the default log level it contains no wallet or personal data.
